content.title: Review export popover defaults before queuing an export
content.test_md_blob:
# Review export popover defaults before queuing an export

> Prove the export popover presents the complete action list, shared action chrome, complete format list, and CSV as the initial selected format before any export is queued.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} and land on the portfolio dashboard view where the Export control is available.

## Step 2

Open the Export popover and verify the action list shows exactly four actions titled Export Current View, Export Holdings, Export Transactions, and Export Risk Report.

## Step 3

Verify each export action row includes an icon and a description in addition to its title.

## Step 4

Verify the Format section shows exactly three options — CSV, JSON, and PDF — and that CSV is the selected option by default.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-119, ac-120, ac-121, ac-122, ac-123, ac-124, ac-125

Confirm absolute check: CSV (equals) — the stated promise: CSV is selected by default as the export format.
